names_for.catalogue_side: Data Catalogue; 'off-the-shelf AI data infrastructure' (Project Apollo); 'Foundational datasets'; 'Karya marketplace' (older case study)
names_for.custom_side: Custom data solutions (Data Collection / data generation services)

operator_role.note: Datasets are 'purchased from us' (DAIA Tech Pvt. Ltd.) and are Karya's own collections; no dataset licence is published, so licensor of record is inferred from the refund policy.

economics_model.note: Karya funds or commissions collection and sells its own datasets; no third-party sellers or commission seen.

who_pays_fee.note: No third-party sellers are listed; Karya sells its own inventory, so there is no marketplace fee.

supply_models.note: Own collection: Project Apollo. Commissioned then resold: KHPT tuberculosis speech data. No third-party provider listings seen.

custody_model.note: Samples sit in a Karya Google Cloud Storage bucket; how full datasets are delivered is not published.

transaction_mode.note: The catalogue has no price or cart; egocentric data is by email to sales. (Platform by Karya tooling has 'Buy Now' plans, but that is not dataset sales.)

public_prices.note: No dataset price appears in the catalogue data or on any page read. Only the Platform by Karya tooling has published prices.

licence_model.note: No dataset licence is published; the website T&C cover site use only. No 'Karya Public License' page found.

public_listing.note: An anonymous visitor sees every catalogue entry with its specifications and sample links; the entries are rendered client-side from a public JS file.

sample_mechanics.note: Speech samples download without login from a public GCS bucket (confirmed 200 on 2026-10-01); the egocentric sample is a Google Drive folder that asks for a Google sign-in.

human_subject_consent_docs.note: Karya says consent is built into its worker platform, but nothing says what, if anything, a buyer receives.

contributor_pay_model.note: Workers are paid wages per task (vendor says about 20x minimum wage) and, at least for the KHPT dataset, are promised royalties on re-sales; royalty rate and mechanism unpublished.

quality_evidence.note: Listings show only hours, speakers and gender ratio. A >95% SLA is claimed for datasets Karya creates, on the services page, not on listings.

Q1.answer: Buyers named are AI labs, big tech, foundations and government (Anthropic, Microsoft, Google, Gates, Maharashtra), mostly for custom work; catalogue units are hours of speech and on-request egocentric video. Why buyers choose catalogue over custom is not stated.

Q2.answer: Karya sells through its own catalogue (earlier called the 'Karya marketplace'); no evidence of listing on third-party marketplaces.

Q3.answer: Inventory comes from Karya's own crowd workforce: self-funded collections (Project Apollo) and data first collected for clients and then resold (KHPT TB speech). Rights terms for either are not published.

Q4.answer: For the KHPT/USAID project Karya stated up front that the dataset would be resold after KHPT's use, and a matching TB dataset is now in the catalogue. The contract carve-out itself is not public, and no dispute was found.

Q5.answer: Datasets are bought from Karya (DAIA Tech Pvt. Ltd.), which appears to be licensor of record; no warranty, consent or indemnity terms for datasets are published.

Q6.answer: Samples are hosted by Karya in a public Google Cloud Storage bucket; delivery of full datasets is not described.

Q7.answer: Karya says worker consent is built into its platform and promises capturing workers royalties on re-sales; nothing covers consent from depicted persons or property owners in egocentric video.

Q8.answer: No dataset licence is published. The only public terms are the website T&C and a no-refund-after-delivery policy; Apollo is described as 'publicly available' without a named licence.

Q9.answer: Deals close through sales contact (catalogue 'Connect with us', egocentric by email to sales); Karya owns the inventory, so there is no commission. Delivered datasets cannot be refunded.

Q10.answer: A catalogue entry is a dataset record (language, type, hours, speakers, gender ratio, domain, sample link); orders are final once delivered. Revisions and entitlements are not described.

Q11.answer: Buyers see summary stats and can download free samples; Karya claims a >95% SLA on datasets it creates.

Q12.answer: Karya runs custom data solutions and a Data Catalogue of foundational or off-the-shelf datasets; client-commissioned collections feed the catalogue, and Project Apollo is its largest self-funded off-the-shelf build.
